title: Writing / Brand Narrative
slide_intent: Connect individual messages to a shared story so audiences encounter a recognizable idea across communications.
strategic_value: The invitation to adapt a common narrative can let Duolingo retain a coherent promise while writers address different situations.
demonstration: A blue introduction pairs the brand-narrative heading and short guidance with Duo reading an open book.
practical_value: Begin a writing brief with the common story before selecting a channel-specific message.
